F1_cube.notes: Cube schema v14. Curated for patch 3.2.3 (Season 15, Hell's Legacy). Upgrade to Mythic is a 1:1 transfer costing 5 Resplendent Sparks (Pandemonium Fragments no longer used by the recipe), with a one-equipped "Crafted" tag. New: Affix Value Reroll, Horadric Reroll, Seasonal Rune Conversion, Classic Runewords. Chaotic/Focused Reroll still removed for Unique + Mythic Unique. 3.2.2: Henri's Perquisition Cube crafting fixed. 3.2.3 (bug-fix only): Cube rerolls restored for Impairment Reduction, Barrier Generation, Healing, Critical Strike Damage. Unique Power Reroll eligibility unconfirmed (Maxroll says Ancestral only).

Undercity, Mephisto and Seals sections still carry 3.1.3 text (unverified for Season 15). Corrupted Reaper / Ruptures / Pandemonium Fragments removed from the guide — Season 15 status unconfirmed.

scanProtocol.summary: Start from the baseline provided for this run. Discover live game state from the web. Emit ALERT only on P0/P1 deltas vs that baseline.
steps: Diff gate: read generatedAt + gameState.knownPatch from the baseline for THIS run. Discard prior chat memory of older patches/seasons/gaps. If this run embeds baseline JSON (Gemini Scheduled Actions), that JSON is sole truth — do NOT fetch remoteUrls.baseline/baselineR2 (may be stale). Otherwise fetch remoteUrls.baseline and abort if unavailable.
Fetch remoteUrls.buildsMetaTierList for F4 cross-check when network is available.
From Tier A sources, determine current season name, patch version, and patch date.
If live patch is newer than gameState.knownPatch → P0. If live patch equals knownPatch, do NOT emit blizzard_patch_newer_than_baseline.
Open web discovery across all discovery.categories (last discovery.recencyDays days).
Any mechanic/term not in knownTopics → mark novelty=NOVEL.
Any term in expectedMissingTopics now mainstream in Tier B–D → P1.
Compare findings to features.F1–F5 knownGaps — confirmed gap → P1. Do not re-alert facts already covered by knownTopics or lastVerifiedPatch notes.
Before P0 “contradicts baseline”: read recipe itemReq/notes and UI copy — listing a recipe name is not claiming it works on all item types.
If zero P0 and zero P1 → output scanProtocol.outputWhenNoChange only.
Else → output scanProtocol.outputWhenAlert in Portuguese (Brazil), max 600 words.
scanProtocol.outputWhenNoChange: D4 Companion scan — [UTC date]\nStatus: NO MATERIAL CHANGES\n(baseline generatedAt, gameState unchanged)
scanProtocol.outputWhenAlert: Markdown alert in pt-BR: Resumo, P0, P1, NOVEL, Delta por feature F1–F5, Fontes com URL+data. Tell Diego to paste into Cursor — do not edit the app.
